name: Airport Control 25
detailed_description:
Airport Control 25 is a next-generation 3-D air-traffic-control simulation built for serious aviation enthusiasts.

✈️ 1:1 Authentic Airport Infrastructure

  • Animated boarding bridges — single, dual, and triple-bridge stands

  • Full airfield lighting suite — ILS, rabbit strobes, PAPI, runway / taxi-way edge & centerline lights

  • Exact markings — taxiway and runway designators, stand lead-in / lead-out lines

  • Operational limits modelled — pavement class, wingspan restrictions, turnaround pads

📻 Bilingual Dynamic Radio

  • AI-generated ATC and pilot read-backs that mirror your clearances in real time

  • Multinational pilot accents; phraseology selectable in English or Mandarin

🗺️ Complete Arrival & Departure Flow

  • Authentic SID / STAR / APP procedures with altitude and speed constraints

  • One-click assignment of predefined taxi and departure routes

🛫 Ground Handling Freedom

  • Select push-back position and nose orientation

  • Queue commands: follow preceding aircraft, follow-me car, give-way at intersections

  • Runway ops: line-up & wait, take-off, rejected take-off, designated high-speed exits

  • Special cases covered — pause taxi, hold short at TWY/RWY and more

🌎 Built for Simulation Purists

  • Photoreal scenes and modular airports, with new fields and aircraft added over time

  • Native 4K & ultra-wide support

  • Steam Workshop (planned) — share custom liveries, aircraft, airports, and flight schedules

Command the flow, keep the skies safe, and prove you can run an airport down to the last clearance.

short_description: Airport Control is a next-generation 3D ATC simulation. Take the positions at airports worldwide—marshalling taxis, sequencing departures, and spacing arrivals. Remember: Safe, orderly, expeditious.
supported_languages:
Simplified Chinese*, English*
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400, AMD Ryzen 5 1400, or better
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1050Ti, AMD Radeon RX 470 graphics card or better (min 3GB VRAM, DX11 support)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700, AMD Ryzen 7 3800X, or better
  • Memory: 16384 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce RTX 2070, AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT, Intel Arc A750 graphics card or better (min 8GB VRAM, DX12 support)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
